meaning: Using a bank's website or app to check accounts, move money, or pay bills over the internet.
clues: It is a way to do money tasks without going to a branch.
You use a website or app and sign in to see your account information.
You may check a balance, move money, or pay a bill there.
The FDIC says to check the web address and never give your sign-in details to someone who contacts you.
Its name has two words and starts with O.
assumes: An ATM is a machine that lets you do some bank tasks in person.
A check deposit sends a paper check to a bank.
A bank branch visit means doing a task with staff at a bank building.

decoys.meaning: An automated teller machine, a bank machine where you can do some banking. Using another bank's machine may cost a fee.
Giving a paper check to a bank so its value can be added to your account.
Going to a bank building to do a money task with its staff.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Try it with someone you trust. Find your bank's help page, then check the web address before you sign in.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: We used to walk into a branch to ask for a balance. Checking it from home can save a trip.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Never share your sign-in details with someone who contacts you. Call the bank using a number you already trust.

short: Banking through a website or app

situations.text: You check the web address of your bank's site before you sign in.
situations.why: Checking the web address before you sign in helps you avoid a fake site.
